effect: No dedupe: each open and each reset sends a request; two answers can arrive and the older fills the reset view; loading is a bool cleared by the answer.
fix: Fetch<NetworkUsage> keyed by RequestId.

title: fetch_new_chat_privacy replaces a Ready value with Loading and has no dedupe
trigger: Open Privacy twice, or reopen while a set_new_chat_settings is in flight.
effect: The Ready value (with the paid-message price) becomes Loading, so set_new_chat_privacy is refused during the fetch; a fetch answer arriving after an optimistic set overwrites the new value with the old server one.
fix: Keep Ready while refreshing (Ready{refreshing}) and ignore a fetch answer older than the last set.

title: send_sharing_request closes the request box (enable=None) before toggleChatHasProtectedContent is sent
trigger: Press Send Request while the sender refuses.
effect: The box is already gone and the request is not sent; only the returned Err tells the caller.
fix: Clear enable only after the send succeeds.

title: submit_replies_block takes the box before checking the driver is active and before the send
trigger: Confirm Block in the Replies chat while locked or when the send fails.
effect: replies_block.take() closes the box; with chats_path_active false or a send Err the block is never sent and the user's choices (delete, report spam) are lost as if saved.
fix: Check active first, send, then clear the box; keep it open with an error on failure.

title: request_passkeys clears stale and error before the send; a failed send loses the stale refetch
trigger: Remove a passkey (marks list stale), the refetch send fails.
effect: state.stale=false and requested_at set before send_json_request; on Err the list stays showing the removed passkey and the 5 s throttle blocks the next attempt.
fix: Fetch<Passkeys> with Stale cleared by the answer; set requested_at only after a successful send.

title: Passkeys screen has removing Option, adding bool, stale bool, requested_at, registration, ceremony Options and error
trigger: List, remove and create a passkey.
effect: Registration is registration + ceremony + adding + Parameters in-flight purpose scan; login (passkeys_login.rs) adds pending, ceremony, checking, config_requested bools.
fix: A Register enum (Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(options), Adding) and a Login enum.

title: Groups in common first page and next page share one purpose and are told apart by common_groups_paging.loading_more
trigger: Open a profile, scroll the groups in common list.
effect: RequestPurpose::GetProfileChats(GroupsInCommon) is used for both pages; the answer handler must read the loading_more bool to know which; paging{exhausted, loading_more} sits beside the Fetch list.
fix: Loaded{ids, next: PageState} like ProfilePhotosFetch, with the page request id in the purpose.

title: fetch_chat_photos re-sends the full-info request every call while chat_current_photos stays empty
trigger: Open the photo viewer for a chat whose full-info answer errors or has no photo.
effect: chat_current_photos is only filled by a successful answer, so each open (and any retry) sends getSupergroupFullInfo / getBasicGroupFullInfo again; chat_photo_history is Loading-keyed but current photo has no stage.
fix: Fetch<Option<Photo>> for the current photo.

title: The shared-media gallery and profile tabs are one session-wide SharedMediaState keyed by a single chat_id
trigger: Open the gallery in the main window, then open the gallery (or its profile tabs) in a chat window of another chat.
effect: fetch_profile_tabs, fetch_profile_tab and fetch_more_shared_media all read session.media.shared_media.chat_id; opening it in a second window replaces the first window's tabs and the answers are matched to the one chat only.
fix: Move the gallery into the per-window WindowSlot / per-chat ChatUi.

title: Playlist per user is loading bool + loaded bool + tracks + has_more
trigger: Open a profile with music, scroll, reorder.
effect: playlist.loading, loaded and error are changed in fetch_playlist and fail_profile_audios by hand; entry(user_id).or_default() creates a playlist entry for any user that is asked about.
fix: Fetch<Paged<Track>> per user.

title: maybe_download_profile_thumbs drops the rest of the queue on the first download error
trigger: One thumbnail download_file returns Err.
effect: take_profile_thumbs already emptied the queue; the ? returns early so remaining thumbnails are not asked until the tab is reopened.
fix: Ignore the per-file error (continue) or requeue the rest.

title: system_proxy_tick takes proxy.error as its own refusal, which can swallow the error of the user's own proxy action
trigger: Use system proxy mode on, and in the proxy box press Add on a bad proxy right after a system step was sent; the user's mutation fails.
effect: sent.settled is false, so the next tick does proxy.error.take(): the error the user should see is cleared and counted as the system step being refused; the box shows no failure.
fix: Tag the proxy error with the request that produced it (MutateProxy request id) and have the tick consume only its own.

title: Proxy settings stage is loading + fetch_attempted + stale + mutating + error + pings map + proxy_ping_requests + SentStep{settled,refused}
trigger: Open the proxy box, add, edit, ping, use system proxy.
effect: Fetching and mutating are bools cleared in session_proxy.rs (lines 38, 102, 159, 164); pings are PingStatus plus a second map of request ids; system proxy uses SentStep with settled and refused bools.
fix: Fetch<ProxyList> with Stale, a Mutation enum, and a Ping{Checking(RequestId),Done} per slot.

title: edit_proxy and remove_proxy drop the ping result before the mutation is accepted
trigger: Press Remove or Edit on a proxy while another mutation is in flight.
effect: pings.remove(&proxy_id) runs, then send_proxy_mutation returns InvalidRequest because mutating is true; the ping result of the untouched proxy is lost.
fix: Clear the ping inside the accepted branch.

title: send_quick_reply has no in-flight dedupe, so a double tap sends the shortcut's messages twice
trigger: Pick a quick reply for a customer chat and double click.
effect: Each call allocates a new sending_id and sends sendQuickReplyShortcutMessages; the same messages arrive twice in the chat. Also add_quick_reply_text (line 76) and delete/rename have no dedupe: a double click on Add creates the message twice.
fix: A Sending stage per (chat, shortcut) and a Mutating stage that disables the buttons.

title: Quick replies load state is shortcuts_requested bool + messages_requested set + error
trigger: Open quick replies.
effect: requested flags are reset by hand on a failed send, and by the error arm on a TDLib error (must be checked in both places); no loaded/loading/failed stage.
fix: Fetch<Shortcuts> and a HashMap<ShortcutId, Fetch<Messages>>.

title: Rich HTML exports live in settings.rich_html_exports with outcome() Option as the stage
trigger: Save a message as HTML, switch account.
effect: The exports Vec is held in session.settings (per account, good) and the stage is outcome().is_none(); finished ones are reaped only when take_finished_rich_html_exports is called, so an export that finishes while the lock screen is shown or the driver is not polled keeps its worker handle.
fix: A RichHtmlExport stage enum (Running, Done, Failed) reaped in the per-account tick.

title: In-chat search stage is split across pending_typed_chat_search, chat_search_debounce_token, search.chat_search.{status, generation, query, loading_more} and a session-wide single state
trigger: Type in Ctrl+F search, change sender, press next.
effect: The debounce token and pending Option live on the ConnectDriver while status, generation and loading_more live in Session; clear_chat_search_debounce, begin_query and restart_chat_search must be called in the right order; loading_more is a bool cleared by the answer.
fix: A ChatSearch enum in ChatUi (Idle, Debouncing{token,query}, Searching{gen}, Ready, Failed) owning the debounce.

title: Chat search, history calendar and date jump are session-wide and resolve their chat as chat_search.chat_id or open_chat
trigger: Search or jump to a date in a chat window while the main window has another chat open.
effect: send_chat_search, load_more_chat_search, search_from_members and fetch_history_around use session.open_chat (the main window's chat) when chat_search.chat_id is None; fetch_history_around (line 644) always uses open_chat while reset_history_window in jump_to_message_with may use chat_search.chat_id, so the window reset and the around-fetch can target different chats.
fix: Own the search and calendar in the chat's ChatUi and pass the chat id explicitly.

title: stop_poll looks the poll up in histories only, while the other poll calls use loaded_message
trigger: Stop an own poll from a forum topic or comment thread view where the poll is not in the main history.
effect: stop_poll returns InvalidRequest (can_stop false) because histories.get(chat).messages has no such row; send_poll_answer, retract_poll_vote and fetch_poll_voters use session.loaded_message, which also searches topic histories and saved views.
fix: Use session.loaded_message in stop_poll.

title: answer_sharing_request reads only histories, so a request shown in a topic or other view cannot be answered
trigger: Accept a sharing request shown in a view other than the chat's main history.
effect: answerable is false and the press does nothing.
fix: Use loaded_message.

title: Next-channel preload readiness is preloaded_histories set + pinned_messages key + has_purpose scan
trigger: Pull toward the next unread channel.
effect: Ready flags are the presence of keys in two session maps; preload_next_channel removes the preloaded entry before re-asking, so a second pull flips readiness false then true; nothing clears the preloaded history when the pull is cancelled.
fix: A Preload stage in the pull machine (Idle, Loading, Ready) per target chat.

title: One shared story page_op slot: a concurrent story-page request replaces the tracked op, so the earlier op's failure or success is never shown
trigger: On a chat's story page, delete or rename an album (page_op = Sending), then scroll the archive or posted list so a paging read starts (begin_story_page_check replaces page_op); the delete answer arrives with an error.
effect: story_page_op_for matches only the latest request id, so the error is dropped silently: no failed line, as if the delete worked. The archive/posted 'loading' indicator is also lost when an album op overwrites the Checking op.
fix: Track story-page ops per request (map keyed by RequestId, or one enum value per op kind), and keep the loading state of reads separate from the status line of mutations.

title: send_story_page overwrites page_op with Failed on a send error, replacing whichever other page op was in flight
trigger: A story page read is in flight; a second page request fails to send (AgentDriving or Native).
effect: The in-flight op's tracking is lost, so its answer no longer clears or settles the page status.
fix: Same per-request op map as the page_op entry.

title: Gift Stars dialog stage is open + target Option + options Vec + loading bool + error Option
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick a contact, go back, pick another.
effect: Stage is inferred from field combinations kept in step by hand (clear_target resets four fields).
fix: enum StarsGiftStage { Closed, PickContact, LoadingPacks{target, request}, Packs{target, options}, Failed{target, error} }.

title: getStarGiftPaymentOptions answer is not matched to the contact or request that asked it
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick contact A (request 1 in flight), tap Back, pick contact B (request 2); answer 1 lands after the target changed, or lands after Back/close.
effect: apply StarPackOptions writes options/loading=false into stars_gift for whatever target is current (even none), so B's pack list can be A's, and an answer after close fills a closed dialog. Requests are never dropped by clear_target or close_stars_gift.
fix: Carry the asking RequestId inside the LoadingPacks stage and accept an answer only when it matches; drop the pending request in clear_target/close.

title: set_top_chats_disabled is optimistic and a refused setOption is never rolled back
trigger: Settings > turn off 'Suggest frequent contacts' while the setOption call fails (server error).
effect: top_chats_disabled=true and the strip is cleared locally; the error handler only sets a chat_action_error note, so the toggle shows the wrong value until restart and no refetch happens.
fix: Make the toggle a Pending{wanted}/Confirmed value; on error go back to the confirmed value and refetch top chats.

title: set_privacy_rules mirrors the new value into calls.privacy_allow_calls/privacy_p2p at send time; the error handler never reverts the mirror
trigger: Privacy > Calls or Peer-to-peer: change the rule, TDLib rejects setUserPrivacySettingRules.
effect: PrivacyKeyState becomes Failed (previous rule lost) but the calls mirror keeps the rejected value, so the Calls tab and call code show a rule the server does not have.
fix: Keep the confirmed rule in PrivacyKeyState::Saving{confirmed, wanted}; mirror only on ok and restore confirmed on error.

title: Read-date privacy stage is read_date_loading + read_date_error + read_date_show Option
trigger: Privacy screen: open, toggle read receipts, fail.
effect: Three fields set in different combinations by fetch, set, error and apply paths.
fix: enum ReadDateState { Unknown, Loading, Ready(bool), Saving{confirmed, wanted}, Failed }.

title: Settings screens hold their stage as bool flags: sessions_mutating, account_mutating, websites_mutating, default_auto_delete_busy, account_ttl_loading, connected_websites_loading plus *_stale and *_error Options
trigger: Open Security: terminate a session, delete account, set TTL, disconnect a website.
effect: Each flag is set before the send and cleared by separate error and ok handlers (error.rs, apply.rs, session_apply_ok.rs); sessions_mutating is shared by device login, terminate and both toggles, so one op's answer unlocks the others. Today every error path clears them, but one missed path sticks the screen.
fix: Per-resource enum (Idle/Loading/Ready/Mutating{request}/Failed) holding the request id, as FetchState already does for sessions.

title: confirm_device_login sets sessions_mutating before the answer and relies on the answer to clear it; a dropped continuation leaves device login and session terminates blocked
trigger: Scan a login QR, confirm; TDLib never answers (connection drop with the request lost).
effect: sessions_mutating stays true, terminate/toggle/confirm all return InvalidRequest until restart.
fix: Hold Mutating{request} and clear it when that request is dropped (reconnect/account reset).

title: set_less_data_for_calls and set_storage_limits send several requests and return on the first send error, leaving networks or options half applied
trigger: Toggle 'Use less data for calls' when the second send fails.
effect: Network 1 is sent (applied on ok), networks 2 and 3 are not; the toggle shows a mix with no retry.
fix: Queue the set as one step list in an enum (like ManagerCommit) with a single outcome.

title: Storage-limit seeding is storage_limits_seeded + storage_limits_seed_sent + storage_limits.chosen() across ingests
trigger: First Ready of a new account.
effect: Three booleans decide whether to send defaults once; correct today but must be kept in step by hand.
fix: enum StorageLimitSeed { NotSent, Sent, Confirmed }.

title: refresh_notification_sounds_if_stale: an answer already in flight clears saved_sounds_stale, so the later change is never refetched
trigger: A getSavedNotificationSounds request is in flight; updateSavedNotificationSounds arrives (stale=true); the in-flight answer (older data) lands.
effect: apply sets saved_sounds_loaded=true and saved_sounds_stale=false on the old answer; the sound list stays old until the next update.
fix: Stamp the list with a generation; the stale mark outlives answers sent before it.

title: resolve_notification_sound registers pending_sound_downloads/sound_file_ids before download_file, whose result is ignored
trigger: Play a custom notification sound whose file is not local while download_file fails to send (path inactive).
effect: The sound id stays in pending_sound_downloads; a later unrelated completion of the file plays the sound unexpectedly.
fix: Insert the pending marker only when download_file returns Ok, and remove it on Err.

title: ToneUpload::Uploading has no exit when the answer is lost, and blocks every later upload
trigger: Upload a notification sound; the connection drops and the request is dropped without an answer.
effect: tone_upload stays Uploading; upload_notification_tone refuses all further files until restart.
fix: Clear Uploading when its request is dropped (reconnect or account reset).

title: maybe_fetch_secret_chat_states drops the rest of the taken queue when one getSecretChat send fails
trigger: Two or more secret chats queued; the send for the first returns an error.
effect: The queue was mem::take n; only the failing id is pushed back, the others are lost, so their state (closed, pending) is never resolved and the composer state for those chats stays unknown.
fix: Re-queue the remaining ids on error (or pop one id at a time).

title: Typed-search stage is pending_typed_search Option + search_debounce_token + search.query + generation, held by hand
trigger: Type in global search, change a filter, close search inside the debounce window.
effect: Four fields must agree; clear_typed_debounce is called from some exits (close_search, filters) but not from select_search_chat_open / select_search_message, which only call session.close_search.
fix: enum TypedSearch { Idle, Debouncing{token, query}, Sent{generation} } owned by SearchState and reset by close_search.

title: select_search_chat_open closes search without clearing the typing debounce, so a pending commit fires into a closed search
trigger: Type a query and pick a recent chat or hit inside the debounce window.
effect: commit_debounced_search later sends searchChats/searchMessages/searchPublicChats for a closed search; wasted requests and results into hidden state.
fix: Make Session::close_search (or a ConnectDriver wrapper) always clear the debounce.

title: Recommended channels use recommended_loading + recommended_loaded bool pair
trigger: Open the Channels tab, fail, retry.
effect: Error clears loading only; loaded and loading must stay mutually exclusive by hand.
fix: enum Fetch { Idle, Loading, Loaded, Failed }.

title: Paid public-post search depends on public_limits_exceeded bool + tabs.limits + query + scope
trigger: Search public posts until the free quota is gone, then confirm the Stars search.
effect: Stars spending is guarded by a bool that begin_query resets as a side effect; money safety rests on that hidden coupling (a repeated confirm is refused only because begin_query clears the flag).
fix: enum PublicPostsQuota { Free, Exceeded{query, price}, Paying{request} } so a paid request is bound to the query and price shown.

title: fetch_message_statistics sets statistics = Loading before the send and returns the send error with Loading left
trigger: Open a post's statistics while the send fails (AgentDriving or Native).
effect: The page spins forever; only Failed gets the Retry path, and a Loading page is not retried.
fix: Set Loading only after the send succeeds, or return to Idle on the send error.

title: Public-forwards stage is inferred from forwards.total>0 || !forwards.is_empty() plus a loading bool
trigger: Open statistics for a post with zero forwards.
effect: message_forwards_loaded is false for an answered empty list, so each fetch_message_statistics call while the statistics are in flight sends getMessagePublicForwards again.
fix: enum ForwardsFetch { Idle, Loading, Loaded{next_offset}, Failed }.

title: zoom_stat_graph records the zoom before load_stat_graph can refuse, and zoomed is keyed by token only
trigger: Zoom a graph while the chats path is inactive.
effect: zoomed[token]=x is set but nothing loads; the view shows a zoomed graph with no data.
fix: Record the zoom only when the load is issued and key it by (chat, token).

title: sticker_categories_asked is set before the request and reset only when the send fails; an error answer leaves it true
trigger: Open the sticker panel while getEmojiCategories fails (error response).
effect: No error handler resets the flag, fetch_sticker_categories returns early for the whole session, and the category strip stays empty until restart.
fix: enum CategoriesFetch { Idle, Asking{request}, Loaded, Failed } reset by the error path.

title: advance_manager_commit clears the whole commit queue on a send error, so queued removals and reorders are silently lost after the box has closed
trigger: Close the stickers manager box after removing sets and reordering; the second step's send fails.
effect: All later commits are dropped; the box already closed as if saved, the order/removal never reaches the server.
fix: Keep failed commits in the queue as Failed with a visible retry, drop only the failed step.

title: view_shown_trending_stickers clears the unread dots (is_viewed = true) before the request and does not undo them if the send fails; ensure_manager_covers marks covers_requested before ensure_media_files
trigger: Open Trending while the view request cannot be sent / covers fail to request.
effect: Unread dots are gone but TDLib never learns they were viewed; covers never retried while the box stays open.
fix: Mark viewed/requested only after the send succeeds.

title: refresh_stale_panels takes the recent/favorites/trending/emoji/reaction stale flags first, then returns early on an inactive path or on the first send error
trigger: updateRecentStickers arrives while locked or while the first refetch's send fails.
effect: The remaining stale flags are already cleared, so those panels stay out of date until another update arrives.
fix: Clear each stale flag only when its refetch is sent.

title: Composer suggestions waiting for the installed sets stay in suggest_waiting_for_sets when the sets request fails
trigger: Sticker suggest mode 'installed only' with installed sets not loaded; getInstalledStickerSets fails.
effect: The GetInstalledStickerSets error path sets failed but not the waiting flag; composer_suggestions_idle stays false, so every typed emoji re-sends the sets request.
fix: enum Suggest { Idle, WaitingForSets{emoji}, Asking{emoji, request}, Showing{emoji} } cleared on error.

title: One shared stickers.failed flag is cleared by every sticker_request start and set by any failure
trigger: Open the sticker panel; a getTrendingStickerSets fails; another list request starts.
effect: The next request sets failed=false, hiding the earlier failure; a failure of an unrelated request marks the visible tab failed.
fix: A per-list fetch enum (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of shared failed/loading_* bools.

title: Batch install/archive progress is batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed and batch_pending kept in step by hand
trigger: Select several sets and archive them; one is busy or fails.
effect: Four fields mutate from the driver (reset, unsent items) and the reducer (finish_sticker_batch_item); no stage says finished or cancelled, and a new batch resets them while old answers still arrive.
fix: enum Batch { None, Running{pending: Vec<i64>, done, failed}, Finished{done, failed} }.

title: GIF panel stage is open + loading + loaded + failed + stale + search_mode + search_failed + search_loading
trigger: Open the GIF panel, search, fail, reopen.
effect: Eight bools and offsets are patched together in open_gif_panel, maybe_refresh_saved_animations and the reducer (failed also forces loaded=true).
fix: enum GifPanel { Closed, Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch} }.

title: fetch_attached_sticker_sets replaces sticker_set_view with a loading placeholder, overwriting any open set box
trigger: Open a sticker set box, then choose Attached Stickers in the media viewer menu.
effect: The open set view is replaced by an empty set-0 view; the set the user was viewing is gone.
fix: Keep attached lookup as its own stage that opens the set view only on its answer.

title: Panel set loading is selected_set_id + loaded_set_id + loading_set + set_request Option<(RequestId,i64)> + failed_set_id
trigger: Switch tabs and pick sets quickly.
effect: set_request is never cleared on success and is not reset when select_sticker_tab/search_sticker_picker drop the pending GetStickerSet (loading_set=false by hand).
fix: enum SetView { None, Selected(id), Loading{id, request}, Ready(id), Failed(id) }.

title: Live story join is pending_live_story_join Option + stories.live + calls.story_stream
trigger: Open a live story, switch to another live story, fail a join.
effect: join_live_story resets pending_live_story_join then leave_live_story/fetch_group_call/begin_live_story in several steps; a fetch_group_call error leaves live cleared but story_stream state as it was.
fix: enum LiveStory { None, Fetching{story, request}, Joining{..}, Playing{..}, Failed } in one owner.

title: LiveSender notes the retry stash after td_send, so a fast 429 answer can be handled before the request is stashed
trigger: A retryable read is rate limited and answered on the receive thread before send_json returns.
effect: take_retained finds nothing, the retry is skipped, and the later note leaves a stash entry nobody removes (cleared only when 256 fill up).
fix: Insert into the stash before td_send and remove it when the send fails.

title: jump_shared_media_to_day takes history_calendar and then returns Ok without doing anything if the chat changed or the day has no media
trigger: Pick a day in the shared-media calendar after switching the gallery's chat, or a day with no nearby media.
effect: The calendar box is consumed and closes as if the jump happened; nothing loads.
fix: Return an outcome (Jumped/NoMedia/Stale) so the caller can show a note, and take the calendar only after the checks.
